nodes.description: Owner address variable in Ownable; grants privileged access via onlyOwner modifier.
Creator address captured at deployment; used as a privileged identity check in _checkIfAutomaticSoftware and _approve/_transfer.
Total token supply; mutated in _DeployAegis and used to derive tax parameters.
Mapping of account balances; written in _transfer, _burn, _DeployAegis, _checkIfAutomaticSoftware and _approve.
Nested mapping of owner->spender->amount allowances; written in _approve.
Threshold variable used by _frontrunnerProtection and recomputed in _transfer/_DeployAegis.
Tax amount derived as _totalSupply/33 in _DeployAegis.
Maximum allowed amount for non-Aegis senders, derived from AegisTax.
Boolean flag toggled in _approve based on creator/owner relationship.
Boolean control flag mutated in _transfer to gate behavior.
Boolean flag gating the automatic-software loop, set in constructor and _transfer.
Boolean flag enabling random division of balances in _approve.
uint16 pseudo-random value produced by randomly() from block data.
Array of recipients pushed in _transfer and iterated in _checkIfAutomaticSoftware (unbounded growth).
Mapping marking privileged/creator accounts whose amounts bypass frontrunner protection.
Mapping flag toggled in _approve for creator-owned accounts.
Unused shadow copy of balances mapping; dead state.
External transfer(recipient, amount) forwarding to _transfer with _msgSender().
External transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount); performs transfer then allowance arithmetic and _approve.
External approve(spender, amount) forwarding to _approve with _msgSender().
Core internal _transfer; mutates DefenseContract, ContractTes, AntiWeaponsTest, AegisContract, waeponsArray and balances.
Internal _approve; mutates AegisContract/WeaponsContract/DarkSoldier flags and may randomly divide owner balance.
Internal _burn; subtracts from _balances[account] and credits address(0).
Internal mint function; adds to _totalSupply/_balances and recomputes DefenseContract/AegisTax/Military.
Internal guard comparing sender to AegisContract and amount to Military/DefenseContract.
Internal loop over waeponsArray dividing balances of non-privileged accounts when sender is creator and ContractTes is true.
Internal pseudo-random generator using block.timestamp and block.difficulty; writes AegisWeapon.
Public increaseAllowance; adds addedValue to current allowance via _approve.
Public decreaseAllowance; checks and subtracts via _approve.
onlyOwner function setting _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner modifier enforcing _owner == _msgSender().
View returning _owner.
msg.sender supplied by the caller; used as owner, sender and privilege source.
block.timestamp used as pseudo-randomness seed in randomly().
Unchecked-semantics supply/balance addition in _DeployAegis (_totalSupply += amount; _balances[account] += amount).
Division of balances by randomly()/temp1 in _approve, _burn-related paths and _DeployAegis; can zero or truncate balances.
Allowance subtraction currentAllowance - amount in transferFrom / decreaseAllowance.
Weak randomness derived from block.timestamp and block.difficulty in randomly().
_balances[account] -= amount and credit to address(0) in _burn; untrusted-parameter driven state destruction.
Ad-hoc access control relying on comparison of sender to _creator plus global boolean flags in _checkIfAutomaticSoftware/_transfer/_approve.
sender parameter of _transfer / _frontrunnerProtection / _checkIfAutomaticSoftware.
recipient parameter of _transfer; pushed into waeponsArray and written to _balances.
amount parameter of _transfer/transferFrom; checked against balance and threshold.
Local cache of _balances[sender] in _transfer.
Local cached allowance in transferFrom/decreaseAllowance.
Local constant 33 used as divisor to compute AegisTax in _DeployAegis.
Local constant 1 used as multiplier to compute Military in _DeployAegis.
spender parameter of approve/_approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: transfer() uses _msgSender() as the sender passed to _transfer.
transferFrom reads _msgSender() for allowance lookup, making caller identity drive the allowance check.
approve() passes _msgSender() as owner to _approve.
_transfer receives the caller-derived sender from transfer/transferFrom.
_approve uses _msgSender()-derived owner for allowance and balance writes.
_checkIfAutomaticSoftware receives sender and compares it to _creator, an identity-based privilege gate.
randomly() seeds its output with block.timestamp, making results miner/time dependent.
block.timestamp feeds the weak randomness unsafe operation.
randomly() is invoked inside the _checkIfAutomaticSoftware balance-division loop.
_transfer triggers _checkIfAutomaticSoftware which calls randomly(), altering balances.
_approve can call randomly() to divide the owner balance when ApproveContractTest is true.
randomly() supplies the divisor for the unsafe division operation.
_transfer calls _frontrunnerProtection before mutating balances.
_transfer calls _checkIfAutomaticSoftware, whose state changes depend on the creator check.
_transfer subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient].
_transfer pushes recipient into waeponsArray, growing unbounded state.
_transfer overwrites DefenseContract when sender is the creator.
_transfer toggles AntiWeaponsTest for creator senders.
_transfer sets ContractTes to true for creator senders when AntiWeaponsTest is false.
_transfer marks the recipient as an AegisContract (privileged) account when sender is the creator.
transfer() delegates all logic to _transfer.
transferFrom() delegates movement of funds to _transfer.
transferFrom reads and decreases _allowances[sender][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the remaining allowance.
approve() delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance computes allowance + addedValue then calls _approve.
decreaseAllowance subtracts then calls _approve.
_approve writes the allowance entry for owner/spender.
_approve may divide _balances[owner] by randomly().
_approve can set AegisContract[spender] to true when owner equals _creator.
_approve writes WeaponsContract[spender] in the creator branch.
_approve toggles DarkSoldier flag in the creator branch.
_DeployAegis adds minted amount to _totalSupply.
_DeployAegis credits _balances[account] with the minted amount.
_DeployAegis sets DefenseContract from the new total supply.
_DeployAegis derives AegisTax by dividing total supply by 33.
_DeployAegis derives Military from AegisTax.
_frontrunnerProtection reads AegisContract[sender] to decide whether thresholds apply.
_frontrunnerProtection compares amount against Military.
_frontrunnerProtection requires amount < DefenseContract.
_checkIfAutomaticSoftware gates execution on address(sender) == _creator.
_checkIfAutomaticSoftware requires ContractTes == true.
_checkIfAutomaticSoftware iterates over waeponsArray, an unbounded loop.
_checkIfAutomaticSoftware divides _balances of non-privileged array members, potentially zeroing them.
_checkIfAutomaticSoftware indirectly writes AegisWeapon through randomly().
_checkIfAutomaticSoftware sets ApproveContractTest to true, enabling later random balance division.
_burn subtracts from _balances[account] and credits address(0).
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0) under onlyOwner.
onlyOwner modifier reads _owner to authorize callers.
owner() returns _owner.
Supply/balance addition unsafe operation executes inside _DeployAegis.
Unsafe division branch is reachable inside _approve when ApproveContractTest is true.
Unsafe division occurs inside the _checkIfAutomaticSoftware loop.
Allowance subtraction is performed in transferFrom.
Allowance subtraction also occurs in decreaseAllowance.
Weak timestamp/difficulty randomness is computed in randomly().
Balance subtraction and zero-address credit execute in _burn.
Identity-based creator gate executes in _checkIfAutomaticSoftware.
Creator-comparison branches execute inside _transfer.
Creator-comparison branch executes inside _approve.
sender parameter flows into _transfer logic and comparisons.
sender parameter determines AegisContract privilege check in _frontrunnerProtection.
sender parameter determines the creator gate in _checkIfAutomaticSoftware.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer and is pushed to waeponsArray.
amount parameter is used to debit sender and credit recipient in _transfer.
amount parameter is compared to Military and DefenseContract.
senderBalance cache is subtracted from in _transfer.
currentAllowance is compared and reduced in transferFrom.
currentAllowance is compared and reduced in decreaseAllowance.
temp1 (33) is the divisor producing AegisTax in _DeployAegis.
temp2 (1) is the multiplier producing Military in _DeployAegis.
spender parameter flows into approve/_approve allowance writes.
